newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain share index falls 3.01 points in week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain share index falls 3.01 points in week.

text.p: Bahrain's shares index fell 3.01 points in the week ending Thursday amid a drop in trading, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
The index fell to 1,522.51 points from 1,525.52, the bourse said.
Around 6.7 million shares worth 1.55 million dinars ($4.1 million) changed hands this week, down from more than nine million shares worth 1.58 million dinars the previous week.
Shares of 25 companies out of 39 registered on the bourse were traded in 175 transactions.
The bourse said Bahrain International Bank led the market with 1.88 million shares worth 320,162 dinars changing hands. Its shares gained five fils to close on Thursday at 168 fils.
It said 724,837 shares of Al-Ahli Commercial Bank worth 228,809 dinars were traded unchanged at 316 fils.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
